watch.en: Let the dough rest once it has been cut or shaped.
watch.de: Den Teig nach dem Schneiden oder Formen ruhen lassen.

why.en: Resting lets the gluten strands relax and helps keep the dough from shrinking.
why.de: Beim Ruhen entspannen sich die Kleberstränge, und der Teig zieht sich weniger zusammen.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: rest the dough once it has been cut to allow the gluten strands to relax and help prevent the dough from shrinking.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: This allows the gluten strands to relax and get ready for the final stages of the process.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Cereal Doughs and Batters, Gluten Relaxation, p. 523
sources.sentence: the dough structure gradually relaxes into a flatter, more malleable mass.

sources.title: Der junge Koch / Die junge Köchin (Brandes, Harten, Krödel, Voll, Wolffgang), 38th edition, Pfanneberg 2022
sources.place: 4 Eiweiß/Proteine, Klebereiweiß bildet das Gerüst im Teig (margin note 'Eigenschaften des Klebers'), p. 123
sources.sentence: sie können sich aber auch wieder verkürzen
